title: Rejected: dummy-index swap orbit is not a tensor generator
expression_sketch: T(i,j)*v(i)*v(j) + T(j,i)*v(j)*v(i).  Einstein dummies i,j. The second summand is the first after relabeling (i,j)->(j,i). Claimed 'generator' T_gen with orbit {id, swap} is only index renaming.
latent_structure: Dummy-index rebinding. Apparent permutation orbit has equal dummy summations, not a new invariant basis or Young/Clebsch generator.

source_provenance: Author-constructed anti-pattern matching frozen representation-bench tensor-family tasks (dev-c-tensor-family / S2-pos-tensor-orbit), which this line rejects as representation.

public_source: in-repo anti-pattern (representation-bench tensor-family); not a scientific identity
why_not_cse_lgg: Even CSE is enough: the two summands are identical after dummy relabeling. That is why this is not an R8 case.
notes: Preserved reject per ADMISSION_GATE. Mission rule: reject if the 'representation' is just index renaming. Contrasts with ac-t-young-s3 (signed non-constant orbit) and ac-t-eps-delta (change of generator).
reject_reason: The two summands are the same Einstein contraction after dummy-index relabeling. An equal-weight swap orbit is notation, not an invariant basis, Young projector, Clebsch-Gordan reduction, or tensor generator.
